requirements.description: Discard exactly the candidates that map any record outside declared sites, regardless of bin. Choose one candidate per station per complete calibration and enforce every benchmark equality simultaneously, including links on non-dice and multiple links on a pair. Report only globally witnessed candidate support and statuses; raise ValueError when no complete assignment exists.

Return the exact JSON-serializable calibrated envelope, canonical IDs and y-then-x die order, declaration-ordered support with lexically sorted candidate IDs, and all and only witnessed statuses in pass/incomplete/fail order. Fail dominates skip or missing, and picks are precisely the pass-only coordinates even if several calibrations survive. Keep input unchanged and output invariant under reordering sites, records, candidates, or links.

Provide a reproducible regression and run method for the exact 20-station D4 workload. On Linux x86-64 CPython 3.12, one unsampled API call must return the complete output in at most 30 seconds of process CPU measured after construction and before assertions, with all eight candidates per run supported, origin picked, all four axial unit dies fail-only, and every position beyond the local square incomplete-only.
